ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) demonstrated strong financial growth for Q2 and 1H FY27, reporting significant year-on-year increases in operational revenue (+51%), EBITDA (+67%), and PAT (+145%) for Q2FY27. This performance was fueled by robust contributions from its expanding transmission and smart metering businesses, alongside an exponential revenue surge from the Energy Solutions Platform, supported by substantial capital expenditure and new project wins. While the unaudited results highlight impressive operational expansion, the accompanying information notes a substantial net debt of Rs 41,067 crore as of 1HFY27 without providing comparative leverage context.
